dedupe_keys.name: speedtest broadband performance by nbn technology type australia q1 2020

description: This Figshare dataset intersects the Ookla Speedtest global performance tiles for the first quarter of 2020 with NBN Co's geospatial layers of access technology, to show measured broadband speeds by NBN technology type (such as fibre to the premises, fibre to the node, fixed wireless and satellite) across Australia. For each tile of about 600 square metres it gives download and upload speeds, the number of devices and the number of tests, with the NBN technology present. The GeoJSON version has 87,058 rows and 25 fields; CSV map files and a Jupyter notebook are included, and version 2 added latitude and longitude. Coverage: Australia, Speedtest tiles with NBN service, Q1 2020. Format and access: GeoJSON, CSV and an IPYNB notebook on Figshare, free; because Ookla data are CC BY-NC-SA, the page says this derived dataset is too, although Figshare lists CC BY 4.0. Caveats: one quarter only; crowdsourced tests are biased toward active users; the licence conflict should be resolved in favour of the non-commercial terms. Simulation uses: performance by access technology for capacity planning and for comparing technologies in resilience studies of the NBN. Related records: data-ookla-open-data-performance-tiles is the source of the speeds; data-itu-ict-statistics gives national broadband series.
